summary: Elme Communities filed an 8-K reporting a definitive agreement to sell Riverside Apartments, a 1,222-unit community in Alexandria, VA, plus undeveloped land, to FPA Multifamily for $250 million. The deal is structured with a $4 million earnest money deposit, $2 million due immediately and the remainder nonrefundable after an inspection period ending August 20, 2026. Closing is scheduled no later than September 14, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated. The sale is part of Elme's ongoing portfolio rationalization; FPA previously contracted to buy four other Elme properties independently. Watch for completion of inspection and any financing or regulatory hiccups. Risk-arb is minimal due to low specific event risk.
